errors.description: dst_async_reset_n combines src_rst_n with dst_rst_n, so source-domain reset release can asynchronously control destination-domain reset behavior.
src_pulse is a one-cycle src_clk pulse sampled directly in dst_clk, so the destination can miss the event or sample it metastably.
dst_data_o captures the multi-bit src_bus value in dst_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
dst_irq_o combines the raw src_toggle value with destination history and aux_flag, creating unsynchronized reconvergence across clock domains.
aux_seen_o samples src_toggle_i directly in aux_clk without a synchronizer.
